title: Make What We Do pillars image-backed cards
body:
## Summary

Updates the three "What We Do" service pillars from plain light cards to premium image-backed cards.

Changes:
- Adds one custom background image per pillar:
  - Capital Fundraising Strategy
  - Investor Access
  - Deal Structuring, Expansion & Market Entry
- Places each image behind the existing service copy using a layered card structure
- Adds a dark/tinted gradient overlay plus subtle gold radial tint to preserve readability
- Keeps the icon, heading, and bullet hierarchy intact as real text
- Increases card height so the photography has more visual impact
- Preserves equal-height 3-column layout on desktop and clean stacking on mobile
- Keeps motion restrained with a subtle image scale / card lift hover treatment
- Respects reduced-motion settings for the hover lift

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify all three service cards feel visually cohesive and the photography reads as premium rather than generic
- [ ] Check text readability on desktop and mobile, especially over brighter image areas
- [ ] Confirm the cards stay equal height on desktop and stack cleanly on mobile
- [ ] Sanity-check that the chosen imagery direction matches the brand tone you want

### Notes
- I used optimized editorial-style stock photos to approximate the requested visual direction because I do not have direct ChatGPT Image 2.0 generation access in this environment
- If you want, I can do a follow-up pass to swap in a darker or more executive-feeling image set once you review this first version
